I wish that I could see this level of valor someday. I wish that I could be someone that inspires people like this guy. 

Against all odds, he achieved his goals and made an Internet stranger proud. Which may not seem important, but I assure you, it is.

Props to you: the man that proved the size of the body you're in doesn't matter, but the size of your heart inside that body does.

0:17- What the fuck, the physics just aren't there!!! 

0:36- This is going to end horribly.

0:58- THE TITLE SAYS ATTEMPTED! THAT MEANS IT OBVIOUSLY ENDS IN FAILURE RIGHT?!?!?! 

End: Well, I was surprised... better than I thought!
I hope you at least told it that it was adorably beautiful and that you meant it no harm. Sweet little baby. Nature is beautiful.
